# Aahil Afraz

> Software engineer and designer in Philadelphia, currently at Zaro Health (https://zarohealth.com/). Previously a software engineering co-op on Comcast's DevSecOps team, with a return offer. NASA Space Apps 2025 Global Nominee (top 1,290 of 11,500+ teams). Founding engineer of LearnFlow (150+ beta users). Drexel University, B.S. Software Engineering, Minor in Finance, 2028. Also a photographer and the musician Azrael.

## Projects

- [AgentGuard](https://github.com/aahilafraz123/agentguard-merchant): PayPal AI Hackathon. An MCP security proxy that checks AI-agent refunds; cut fraudulent payouts from $809 to $0 at 96% detection precision.
- [AirCast](https://aahilafraz.com/work/aircast): Named a NASA Space Apps Global Nominee (top 1,290 of 11,500+ teams worldwide).
- [Security Analytics Platform](https://aahilafraz.com/work/security-analytics): An LLM-powered security analytics platform covering 9,000+ applications, in one view for engineering leaders.
- [NASDAQ ITCH Order Book](https://github.com/aahilafraz123/itch-orderbook): A C++20 limit order book that rebuilds real NASDAQ ITCH 5.0 data at 12.7M messages a second, p99 417 ns.
- [LearnFlow](https://aahilafraz.com/work/learnflow): A production AI learning platform I founded and launched to 150+ beta users.
- [StockAnalyzer](https://aahilafraz.com/work/stock-analyzer): Enter a stock ticker and get a research report in seconds.
